grammar.pattern: 很 / 非常 / 太 / 真 / 最 + adjective
grammar.purpose: Choose the strength of a description
grammar.explanation: 很 often makes a neutral adjective predicate natural and need not mean an unusually high degree. 非常 is stronger. 真 gives a sincere reaction. 太…了 can praise or complain according to the adjective and context: 太好看了 / 太贵了. 最 selects the highest degree within an understood set; make the comparison set clear.

examples.zh: 这件衣服很好看，那件非常好看。
examples.py: zhè jiàn yī fú hěn hǎo kàn , nà jiàn fēi cháng hǎo kàn .
examples.en: This item looks good; that one looks very good.

examples.zh: 这个颜色真好看，太好看了！
examples.py: zhè gè yán sè zhēn hǎo kàn , tài hǎo kàn le !
examples.en: This colour looks really good—so good!

examples.py: zhè sān jiàn , bái sè de zuì hǎo kàn .
examples.en: Of these three, the white one looks best.

commonMistakes.right: 这三件衣服，白色的最好看。
commonMistakes.why: Use 最 without 很 before the same adjective, and state the comparison set.

grammar.explanation: An adjective can be the predicate: 包很重; 衣服很好看. Do not routinely put 是 before it. In a neutral positive sentence 很 is often useful without strong “very”; a contrast can omit it, as 白色好看，黑色不好看. Negative adjectives use 不: 不重. A context-sensitive adjective needs an appropriate subject.

examples.py: zhè gè bāo hěn zhòng , nà gè bù zhòng .
examples.en: This bag is heavy; that one is not.

examples.py: yī fú hái méi gān , xiàn zài bù lěng .
examples.en: The clothes are not dry yet; it is not cold now.

commonMistakes.why: Do not add 是 to this neutral adjective predicate.

grammar.explanation: A positive reaction can use 太好看了！ or 真好看！; a complaint can use 太晚了！. The delivery and context carry the emotion. Exclamation marks do not change an ordinary statement into a question. A plain compliment is also valid; choose the intensity to suit the relationship.

examples.py: tài wǎn le ! míng tiān zài kàn ba .
examples.en: It is too late! Let us look again tomorrow.

commonMistakes.why: Use a statement exclamation for praise, not 吗 unless you mean a question.

lines.zh: 我看见你身上的新衣服了。真好看！
lines.py: wǒ kàn jiàn nǐ shēn shàng de xīn yī fú le . zhēn hǎo kàn !
lines.en: I saw your new clothes. They look really good!
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 真的？我觉得白色很普通。
lines.py: zhēn de ? wǒ jué de bái sè hěn pǔ tōng .
lines.en: Really? I think white is ordinary.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这三件衣服，白色的最好看。颜色和你的包一样。
lines.py: zhè sān jiàn yī fú , bái sè de zuì hǎo kàn . yán sè hé nǐ de bāo yī yàng .
lines.en: Of these three, the white one looks best. It is the same colour as your bag.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这家商店很有名，不过这个包很重。
lines.py: zhè jiā shāng diàn hěn yǒu míng , bù guò zhè gè bāo hěn zhòng .
lines.en: This shop is well-known, but this bag is heavy.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我看到那个小包了，它不重。你可以换一个。
lines.py: wǒ kàn dào nà gè xiǎo bāo le , tā bù zhòng . nǐ kě yǐ huàn yī gè .
lines.en: I saw that small bag; it is not heavy. You could change to it.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你在开玩笑吗？我平时不穿白色。
lines.py: nǐ zài kāi wán xiào ma ? wǒ píng shí bù chuān bái sè .
lines.en: Are you joking? I do not usually wear white.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 没开玩笑，我真的觉得好看。别生气。
lines.py: méi kāi wán xiào , wǒ zhēn de jué de hǎo kàn . bié shēng qì .
lines.en: I am not joking; I really think it looks good. Do not get angry.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没有生气。昨天那件衣服还没干。
lines.py: méi yǒu shēng qì . zuó tiān nà jiàn yī fú hái méi gān .
lines.en: I am not angry. Yesterday’s clothes are still not dry.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今天的颜色不差，唱歌的声音也很好听。
lines.py: jīn tiān de yán sè bù chà , chàng gē de shēng yīn yě hěn hǎo tīng .
lines.en: Today’s colour is good, and your singing voice sounds good too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我的汉语还很差，还要多练。
lines.py: wǒ de hàn yǔ hái hěn chà , hái yào duō liàn .
lines.en: My Chinese is still poor; I need more practice.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 现在还早，先喝茶，再唱一次吧。
lines.py: xiàn zài hái zǎo , xiān hē chá , zài chàng yī cì ba .
lines.en: It is still early. Have tea first, then sing once more.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，但别太晚。太晚了，明天上学会累。
lines.py: hǎo , dàn bié tài wǎn . tài wǎn le , míng tiān shàng xué huì lèi .
lines.en: Okay, but not too late. If it is too late, school tomorrow will be tiring.
lines.speaker: b
